title: Tokyo Revengers Gets Pop-Up Stores in Seoul, Taipei, Bangkok
content:
Pony Canyon announced on Tuesday that it will hold "Tokyo Revengers BAKUSO POP UP ASIA TOUR," a pop-up store tour, in Seoul, Taipei, and Bangkok to celebrate the recent debut of Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc ( Tokyo Revengers: Santen Sensō-hen ), the latest arc of the Tokyo Revengers anime.

The pop-up store will have new merchandise for the franchise , including exclusive merchandise for each venue.

The Seoul store will be located at OU-EN Korea in from November 13 to 22. The Taipei store will be located at OU-EN Xinyi Songyan Store from November 27 to December 6. The Bangkok store will be located at MBK Center Special Event Space from January 22 to 31, 2027.

The Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc premiered in Japan on October 2. The arc is streaming worldwide (excluding China) exclusively on Disney+ .

Pony Canyon describes the new arc's story:

The conflict between Tokyo Manji Gang and Tenjiku came to a gruesome end. As each individual carries their sorrow and moves forward on their own path,Takemichi Hanagaki(TAKE‐MITCHY) finds himself in awe of the late Tetta Kisaki. Upon hearing the full truth behind the time leaps, Manjiro Sano (Mikey) makes a crucial decision. After leaving the past behind, Takemichi finally reaches the ultimate future where his beloved Hinata is alive. However, "he" is nowhere to be found. In the era of the “Three Titans,” where three teams battle for dominance, the final revenge begins!

New cast members for the anime include:

• Mariya Ise as Senju Kawaragi

• Naoyuki Shimozuru as Takeomi Akashi

• Shinnosuke Tachibana as Wakasa Imaushi

• Takanori Hoshino as Keizo Arashi

• Hiroki Yasumoto as South Terano

Maki Kodaira ( The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse ) is directing the anime at LIDEN FILMS , replacing Kōichi Hatsumi from previous anime seasons. Hatsumi is now credited with collaborating on overseeing the series scripts. Airi Tsuyuki and Kae Takakura join previous character designers Keiko Ōta and Kenichi Ōnuki . (Tsuyuki and Takakura were animation directors previously in the anime.) Yoshitomo Hara joins Hideki Fukushima as bike and prop designer. Hiroshi Yataka , who worked on photography for previous seasons, is the new compositing director of photography, replacing Hisayoshi Yamamoto from the previous season. LIDEN FILMS is credited for 3D CG work.

Returning staff members include Yasuyuki Mutō in charge of series scripts, Rumi Matsumoto as art director, Kunio Tsujita as color key artist, Satoki Iida as sound director, and Hiroaki Tsutsumi as music composer.

Boy band JO1 will perform the new arc's opening theme song "IGNITE."

title: Permanent London Pokémon Store Will Open By 2029
content:
The upcoming London store is described as being "the first physical retail space for the Pokémon brand outside of Asia." However, the announcement also adds that the London store will be the first of several permanent Pokémon stores which are planned to open in locations outside Asia.

Gaku Susai, Chief Product and Experience Officer at The Pokémon Company International , is quoted as follows: “This new London store will give visitors the chance to step into the world of Pokémon , whether they're discovering the brand for the first time or have been Trainers for years. We hope it becomes a place where everyone can come together, feel like part of a community and enjoy the magic of Pokémon in a whole new way.”

title: 3 Fall 2026 Anime to Watch If You Miss One Piece
content:
One Piece is following a new format starting in 2026, with only 26 episodes released per year. This was a surprising change, as fans had become accustomed to the series airing weekly on Sundays, with occasional breaks. The series’ run this year came to an end with the summer season, and it still has a long wait before returning.

That said, the Fall 2026 season is thriving on its own, with many new series. While dozens of anime offer a variety of elements, three series in particular could fill the void left by One Piece ‘s absence. These include an anime adaptation of a classic manga, a long-running shonen series, and one that is essentially One Piece ‘s replacement this season.

3) Psyren

Psyren is one of the season’s most surprising entries, adapting a manga that came to a premature end after just 100 chapters in Fall 2010. It is a cancelled manga that many fans had lost hope of ever seeing animated. However, 2026 has proven to be a revival era for such series, with Black Torch arriving in the Summer season and proving why cancelled shonen series deserve their own anime adaptations. As a late 2000s manga, Psyren is one of the few series that captures the retro vibe of classics such as One Piece , Bleach , and Naruto .

The anime studio in charge of adapting the series also perfectly captures the retro vibe one would expect from such a manga. With a protagonist like Ageha Yoshina, who embodies the same rebellious and freedom-seeking spirit as Luffy, it is a shonen anime that incorporates the genre’s elements at their best. The unique aspect of this anime is its game-like narrative structure set in an apocalyptic world, keeping viewers engaged as it gradually unveils its mysteries.

2) Black Clover Season 2

What makes One Piece unique is that it is one of the longest-running shonen series, and replacing its vibe requires an anime that follows a similar structure. With Black Clover being one of the biggest shonen series around, the anime’s second season airing this fall is the perfect choice to fill the void left by One Piece . Black Clover ‘s second season is also likely to be one of the series’ final seasons , bringing the narrative that began almost a decade ago to an end. Asta is regarded as one of the most classic shonen protagonists, bringing the same energy that fans love about the genre.

With the second season building toward its climax, the series is giving its main characters new power upgrades, with Asta representing the best of this development. The second season will showcase two different arcs, bringing the narrative to a close across its 26 episodes, likely sometime next year. Honestly, there is no anime better than Black Clover at capturing the vibe of One Piece , as it releases weekly this fall, providing fans with their shonen dopamine fix as it gradually concludes its narrative.

1) Dragon Ball Super: Beerus

There cannot be a better replacement for One Piece this fall than Dragon Ball ‘s new anime , Dragon Ball Super: Beerus . The anime is a remake of the 2015 Dragon Ball Super series, featuring enhanced animation and other improvements that bring its visual quality up to modern standards. What makes this anime a replacement for One Piece is that both series come from the same studio, and the caliber that One Piece has established can only be matched, if not surpassed, by Dragon Ball .

What makes this anime a true replacement for One Piece is that it has also taken over its TV time slot, the same one One Piece used to occupy. With its legacy and fanbase, Dragon Ball Super is the anime fans can turn to for the nostalgia and long-running appeal that One Piece has always provided this Fall 2026.

title: LOVELYZ's Ye-in Jeong Joins The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call Seasons 2-3
content:
Jeong joins returning cast members Ji-Hoon Ju as surgeon Kang-hyuk Baek, Young-woo Choo as Jae-won Yang, Kyung-ho Yoon as Yu-rim Han, and Jae-kwang Jeong as anesthesiologist Gyeong-won Park. Do-yun lee, who directed the first season, will return as director and screenwriter.

Both seasons are in production and will stream exclusively on Netflix . The streamer has not announced premiere dates.

The eight-episode first season of The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call debuted worldwide in January 2025 and became a breakout hit, topping Netflix 's global non-English TV show rankings and sparking strong demand for a sequel. The series is based on the web novel Trauma Center: Golden Hour , written by Han Sani, who is himself an ENT doctor.

The webtoon Trauma Center: Golden Hour is available in English on WEBTOON. The English version recently ended with an epilogue chapter on August 9.

title: Black Clover Season 2 Episode 4 Preview Teases Nacht Fighting Two Supreme Devils
content:
Black Clover Season 2 has released preview images and synopsis for Episode 4 (Episode 174 overall) ahead of its October 24 premiere. The new season officially began on October 3, 2026 , with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide. The anime previously revealed a special Devil Union Asta visual following Episode 3. The official Episode 4 “Day of Atonement” synopsis:

Before Nacht appear two supreme devils: Nahamah, who wields Demon Fire Magic, and Lilith, who wields Demon Ice Magic. The magical power of these two devils is overwhelming, leaving Nacht with no choice but to keep dodging their attacks and buying time. As Nacht fights while risking his life, he recalls a certain event from his past. There is a reason why Nacht continues to fight beyond his limits. Eventually, Nacht finds himself in a desperate situation, unable to even land a single hit on his opponents. Even so, he refuses to give up. By using Devil Union with two devils, he makes a bold move against the highest-ranking devils. As Nacht’s battle for atonement becomes intertwined with memories of his past, what fate awaits him…?

You can see the preview images below:

The main staff for Season 2 includes:

• Director: Ayataka Tanemura

• Series Composition: Keiichiro Ochi

• Character Design: Itsuko Takeda

• Sub-Character Design: Kumiko Tokunaga

• Prop Design: Kosei Takahashi

• Music: Minako Seki

• Animation Production: Studio Pierrot

The opening song by WANIMA is titled “Kienai Riyuu” (The Reason That Won’t Disappear).

ALSO READ: Black Clover Creator Draws Toru Oikawa From Haikyu!! Black Clover Final Volume and Official Guidebook Released, Includes New 15-Page Manga by Yuki Tabata

You can also see the main visual .

The Black Clover manga was serialized in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 2015 to August 2023, before transferring to Jump GIGA . It entered its final arc in August 2022 and officially ended on May 1 after eleven years of serialization. The manga is available to read on Viz Media’s website, MANGA Plus website, and the Shonen Jump mobile app in English.

It received a 170-episode anime adaptation by Studio Pierrot, which ran from 2017 to 2021. The Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King movie premiered on June 16 and is streaming on Netflix. Crunchyroll streams the TV anime, and they describe the story:

In a world where magic is everything, Asta and Yuno are both found abandoned at a church on the same day. While Yuno is gifted with exceptional magical powers, Asta is the only one in this world without any. At the age of fifteen, both receive grimoires, magic books that amplify their holder’s magic. Asta’s is a rare Grimoire of Anti-Magic that negates and repels his opponent’s spells. Being opposite but good rivals, Yuno and Asta are ready for the hardest of challenges to achieve their common dream: to be the Wizard King. Giving up is never an option!

title: Horror Collector Anime Reveals English Dub Cast, October 24 Debut
content:
The English dub cast for the first episode includes:

• Brandon Allan Majella as Fushigi

• Larry Brantley as Jimmy

• Rebecca Danae as Himitsu

• Patrick McAlister as Aoyama

• Rowan Gilvie as Crimson Woman

• Lexa Childress as Hiromi

• UkuLeili as Natsuna

• Jonathan Lim as Raita

• Jordan Chantha Weir as Rin

• Chris Sanders as Sasaki

• Zareen Afzaal as Yui

• Jamie Lee as Yurie

The dub staff includes:

• Studio: Crunchyroll

• Studio Producers: Justin Cook, Michael Harcourt, Nathanael Harrison

• Producer: Samantha Herek

• Adaptation Supervisor: Jarrod Greene

• Adaptation: Audrey Drake Rigg

• Adaptation Prep: Benjamin Tehrani

• Voice Director: Helena Walstrom

• Talent Coordination: Tara A. Williams, Brittni Hurley

• Engineering Managers: Gino Palencia, Brandon Peters

• Engineer: Noah Whitehead

• Mixer: Andrew Tipps

The anime debuted on NHK on October 10. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as it airs in Japan.

Yuki Inaba ( KamiKatsu: Working for God in a Godless World , Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World season 2) is directing the anime at Studio Palette , and is also in charge of series composition. Kaori Yoshikawa ( KamiKatsu: Working for God in a Godless World , Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World season 2) is designing the characters. Masato Kōda is composing the music. Tetsuya Gunji is the audio director.

Yen Press is releasing the novel series and Niko Yuki 's manga adaptation in English for its "JY for Kids" middle-grade imprint, and it describes the story:

The internet is full of creepypastas, cryptid sightings, tales of paranormal activity, and unsolved disappearances. These are mostly rumors and pranks fueled by trolls—entertainment. But the unlucky few learn the hard way that some legends are true. Many of these unfortunate souls are doomed, but their luck may change if they cross paths with the boy in the red hood. He roams from town to town and appears wherever strange things occur. Is he a light in the dark? Or living proof that monsters are all too real...?

Sato writes the novels, Norio Tsuruta is the supervisor, and Yon draws the art for the novel series. Kadokawa started releasing the novel series in June 2015, and published the 29th volume on October 7.

Yuki's manga adaptation ran in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Gene magazine in 2021-2022. Kadokawa published the manga adaptation in one compiled book volume in March 2022.

Yen Press published the sixth novel volume in May 2025, and published the manga in one volume in May 2025.

title: The Apothecary Diaries Director Breaks Silence on Biggest Change in Season 3
content:
The Apothecary Diaries is taking all the spotlight this Fall 2026 anime season with its exciting Season 3. There’s no denying it’s one of the biggest shows of the 2020s, not only within the Seinen demographic but also compared to all the major genres as well. The anime returned a year after the second season reached its bittersweet conclusion, with Maomao leaving the Rear Palace after the Shi Clan’s rebellion failed. With over 57 million copies in circulation, the series has an anime adaptation and even a live-action in the works , along with the ongoing light novel and manga. Written by Natsu Hyuga, the story is loved for its complex themes, clever mystery format, and political intrigue.

Maomao is considered one of the best protagonists in recent years, and there’s no denying she deserves all the praise. While the anime is currently airing its third season , fans can’t ignore the considerable changes made in the anime, especially with the way the story is progressing. The change happened significantly in the second season finale, which features the aftermath of the rebellion. Not long after the premiere of the third season, the anime director shared his thoughts on the story’s progress so far.

The Apothecary Diaries Director Sheds Light on Season 3

In an interview with Mantan Web , Akinori Fudesaka shares, “As the story progresses, the setting gradually shifts westward, so we’ve made subtle, gradual changes in everything from the climate and culture to the color of the earthen walls of the buildings, and even the colors and structure of the clothes the characters wear.”

He also continues, “Up until now, we’ve been able to use generic materials from places like the royal court, but that becomes unusable once we move west. When we started production on the third season, I asked the producer and setting designers to ‘prioritize the art commissioning above all else.”

Fudesaka served as a director in the second season and returned in the third season as well . While it’s obvious that the tone of the story has changed, he also mentions the gradual changes in the color schemes and the clothing of the characters, which point towards a different season and vibe. The characters’ lives have changed significantly in the latest season, but it’s not just their social status. While the first two seasons centered mostly around the Rear Palace, the story is now leaning more towards the neighboring countries, which is the major reason behind the change in color scheme.

What’s Happening in The Apothecary Diaries Season 3?

The second season finale already confirmed that the story will take a major turn after Maomao and Jinshi returned to the capital . The latest season is adapting the fifth volume of the novel, where Maomao had already left the Palace. She is now working as an apothecary at the Verdigris House while her adoptive father, Luomen, has returned to the Imperial Palace as the Court Physician. Not only that, but Jinshi has abandoned his fake identity as a eunuch and the manager of the Rear Palace.

As the Moon Prince and officially the Emperor’s younger brother, Jinshi has now taken on his royal duties at the court. The third season is split into two cours, with the second one scheduled to premiere in April next year as part of the Spring 2027 anime lineup. The latest season opens up with a major crisis as a locust problem leads to a potential food crisis and famine scare. Maomao notices something is strange, and it’s no surprise she wants to get to the bottom of the mystery, which will be of great help to Jinshi.

There’s no denying it’s one of the biggest shows of the 2020s, not only within the Seinen demographic but also compared to all the major genres as well. The anime returned a year after the second season reached its bittersweet conclusion, with Maomao leaving the Rear Palace after the Shi Clan’s rebellion failed. With over 57 million copies in circulation, the series has an anime adaptation and even a live-action in the works , along with the ongoing light novel and manga. Written by Natsu Hyuga, the story is loved for its complex themes, clever mystery format, and political intrigue.

Maomao is considered one of the best protagonists in recent years, and there’s no denying she deserves all the praise. While the anime is currently airing its third season , fans can’t ignore the considerable changes made in the anime, especially with the way the story is progressing. The change happened significantly in the second season finale, which features the aftermath of the rebellion. Not long after the premiere of the third season, the anime director shared his thoughts on the story’s progress so far.
The Apothecary Diaries Director Sheds Light on Season 3

In an interview with Mantan Web , Akinori Fudesaka shares, “As the story progresses, the setting gradually shifts westward, so we’ve made subtle, gradual changes in everything from the climate and culture to the color of the earthen walls of the buildings, and even the colors and structure of the clothes the characters wear.”

He also continues, “Up until now, we’ve been able to use generic materials from places like the royal court, but that becomes unusable once we move west. When we started production on the third season, I asked the producer and setting designers to ‘prioritize the art commissioning above all else.”

Fudesaka served as a director in the second season and returned in the third season as well . While it’s obvious that the tone of the story has changed, he also mentions the gradual changes in the color schemes and the clothing of the characters, which point towards a different season and vibe. The characters’ lives have changed significantly in the latest season, but it’s not just their social status. While the first two seasons centered mostly around the Rear Palace, the story is now leaning more towards the neighboring countries, which is the major reason behind the change in color scheme.
What’s Happening in The Apothecary Diaries Season 3?

The second season finale already confirmed that the story will take a major turn after Maomao and Jinshi returned to the capital . The latest season is adapting the fifth volume of the novel, where Maomao had already left the Palace. She is now working as an apothecary at the Verdigris House while her adoptive father, Luomen, has returned to the Imperial Palace as the Court Physician. Not only that, but Jinshi has abandoned his fake identity as a eunuch and the manager of the Rear Palace.

As the Moon Prince and officially the Emperor’s younger brother, Jinshi has now taken on his royal duties at the court. The third season is split into two cours, with the second one scheduled to premiere in April next year as part of the Spring 2027 anime lineup. The latest season opens up with a major crisis as a locust problem leads to a potential food crisis and famine scare.
